adopted_rules: one image per idea, caption beside/below it
rhythm without mechanical repetition (stagger in portrait)
excluded_elements: numbering uses as if they were steps

tokens.palette_note: ground is --dark #1E1B19 with cream type; accent comes from the job palette (used for 6px tile gaps, caption bars, headline keyword)

type_scale_px_at_1500.headline: 96..44 Archivo 900 (stretch 115, 100-106 at the small end); en breaks only at the author's phrase breaks or inside one phrase, fewest lines first, no one-word line when a smaller size avoids it; floor 14px at 360 (58 at 1500, 48 at 1200) except to avoid a widow; zh 92..56 on the written lines
type_scale_px_at_1500.use_title: 56..50 (1500) display 800, one size per row of matching tiles, bars and titles level; 2 lines, a 3rd line instead of going below 12px at 360

elements.text: Assembled stack beside a wall of tools
Each unit shown open with its contents
Middle box shown open, lid raised

adaptation_rules: semantics explicit: uses (unnumbered) / steps (numbered only with approved step data) / states (unnumbered)

every photo keeps the whole product (scene_product_cropped) and is placed so the product box sits below the headline and above its caption (largest product first); when the scene has too little floor, the photo ends early and the caption sits on the dark ground under it, joined by a fade; only if no placement exists does the caption overlap the lower product (logged)

captions: accent bar, title, optional body, at the tile foot on a scrim/ground; a body or title that arrives truncated ('…'/'...') is cut back to its last whole clause or dropped (logged), never printed truncated
split (n=2): headline on a full-width dark band, two full-height columns below (split_dir 'rows' optional), 6px accent seams; the headline never crosses a photo or seam
bento (n=3, square): tile 1 0.62W full height with the headline on its top scrim, tiles 2-3 stacked; on portrait canvases bento renders as the mirrored stagger mosaic
stagger (n=3): offset mosaic; header panel + tile 1 in one half-width column, tiles 2/3 stacked in the other; stagger_style 'rows' keeps the older row layout; stagger n=2 renders as split

columns: span W-2m under a full-width headline, 6px accent dividers, photos as tall as the whole-product rule allows, captions level on the ground below; 3 columns narrower than min_column_w (400) render as bento (= mirrored mosaic on 4:5, so it differs from stagger)
quad (n=4): 2x2 full bleed, optional centre knock-out with center_asset
zh: headline never wraps beyond the written lines (size steps down instead)
steps without approval -> rendered as uses + BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE note
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
elements above are the measured layout of the main render; real layout is computed by the template rules for each job
rendered by engine/render.py with Chrome --headless=old (no visible window); SVG/PDF not produced (no verified vector path)
copy (panel titles, bodies, headline/kicker agreement) and scene variety come from the set builder; the template only refuses to print truncated text

optional_job_fields.stagger_split: 0.5: seam height of the stacked column in the mosaic
optional_job_fields.first_side: 'left' (default; 'right' for bento-on-portrait) : side of the header column in the mosaic / first photo in rows
optional_job_fields.min_column_w: 400: narrower 3-column layouts become bento (mirrored mosaic on portrait)
optional_job_fields.columns_bottom: m: bottom margin under columns photos
optional_job_fields.photo_min_h: 0.55: shortest a photo may get (fraction of its tile) to keep the product clear of its caption
optional_job_fields.headline_min: 14px at 360 (58 at 1500): smallest en headline size tried before allowing a phrase split
optional_job_fields.headline_min_ideal: 60: smallest size at which one phrase per line is preferred
